content: Named entity recognition (NER) refers to the task of detecting the span and semantic category of entities from a chunk of text. Our implementation uses the current state-of-the-art BERT-MRC model proposed by xiaoya2019ner as a backbone. For English datasets, we use BERT$_\text{Large}$ English checkpoints, while for Chinese we use the official Chinese checkpoints. We report span-level micro-averaged precision, recall and F1-score. Hyperparameters are tuned on the development set of each dataset.
